caption: The drawing shows a rectangular object framed with a decorative golden-brown, wood-like border that features rounded and cylindrical shapes at the corners and along the sides. The object is vertically oriented and divided into two main sections. The upper section contains an octagonal inset panel with a depiction of a woven basket filled with fruit and leaves. The basket is light brown and outlined in dark lines, holding round fruits colored in red, orange, and blue, as well as greenish-yellow leaves. The background inside the octagonal panel is light blue with cloud-like swirls, and the immediate area around the octagon has a floral motif in soft pinks and greens. The lower section of the object is a plain, rectangular, grey area indicating a reflective surface, likely representing a mirror. The name "MARIE FAMULARO" is written in capital letters below the frame at the bottom center. The entire composition is drawn on a beige background with a simple rectangular outline framing the page.
title: Mirror
